messages:
Ava (new Product): Hi team — first day here! quick checklist Qs: 1) how do I get Figma access and the canonical product roadmap? 2) where are research briefs stored and who sets the study scope? cc @Marco :)

Marco (Design): Welcome Ava 44b Figma via Okta (Apps -> Request 'Figma - Redwood'). If it shows pending, ping @Lina. I'll also invite you to 'Product UI Kit' and the 'Redwood Product Kit' files.

Lina (Design Ops): Hi Ava 496 FYI new product hires usually auto-approve during business hours, but we sometimes need manual approvals for external contractors. If pending, DM me and I'll force-invite. Our Figma team is called "Redwood - Product".

Ava (new Product): Thanks! also the roadmap link?

Theo (PM): Confluence: /product/strategy/roadmap (shortlink posted in #product-onboarding). We keep quarterly goals and active initiatives there. For context, check 'recent-bets' and the 'roadmap-archive' for older decisions. I can share the 30-min walkthrough at 4pm PT if you want.

Ava (new Product): 4pm PT works 44c

Marco (Design): Research briefs live in Drive -> design/research/playbooks. Process: PM creates brief (problem, audience, 2-3 questions, success metrics), posts in #design-research with tag "study-request", design ops queues it for screener & recruitment. For quick prototype tests we use a Figma prototype + a results doc in the playbook.

Ava (new Product): good to know. Do you expect a full brief pre-discovery or a note to start the conversation?

Marco (Design): Short briefs are fine to start (problem + assumptions). If discovery uncovers scope, we expand. For big experiments we ask for timeline, stakeholders, and metrics up front. Templates: brief.md and screener-template.md in the playbook.

Access Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Ava. Ticket #ACC-8220. Expected processing 1-2 hours.

Lina (Design Ops): Approved your Figma request manually. Invite sent to your work email. I've added you to research-playbooks and the Product UI Kit.

Ava (new Product): Got the invite and Drive access 60a Thanks everyone. See you at 4pm for the roadmap walkthrough!
